title: 第十七章针对顾晦的阴谋诡计第十八章服药练功进度飙升拳劲凛冽
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
“坐。”
王麻子打了个哈欠，指了指对面的椅子，另一只手也抬了起来，揉了揉又黑又大的眼袋。
“昨天，又熬通宵了？”
金世佳坐在椅子上，笑着问道。
“嗯。”
王麻子点点头。
“金爷，说吧，啥事？”
说罢，王麻子拍了拍自己的脸颊，努力保持清醒。
“还能是什么事？”
“上次拜托你的事情，现在是什么情况？”
金世佳微笑着望着王麻子。
“金爷啊，我的金爷，你昨天才吩咐我做事，今儿个就来找我问进度，大佬，上吊也要喘口气啊！”
王麻子抱怨着说道。
“哈哈哈……”
金世佳笑了起来。
“麻子老弟，是当哥哥的不对……不过，这件事，我背后那位催得有些急，我不是怕老弟你贵人事忙，一时间忘了么，这才来提醒两句……”
“老弟，这事情要是能做好……来日方长哦！”
金世佳摸着下颌胡须，笑容变得意味深长。
“金爷，你放心，你交代的事情我怎么可能不放在心上，这件事已经在做了，那小子以前一直想加入和义堂，略施小计，便能让他上钩！”
“鱼儿上了岸，自然任凭处置！”

“到时候，我准备……”
王麻子嘿嘿笑道。
“兄弟！”
金世佳摆了摆手，打断了王麻子的话。
“具体怎么做的，你不用给我说，我只要那张地契，两亩上好水浇地的地契，你若是能弄到手，这二十两银就是你的，若是办不好，这件事就当我没说……”
“总之，三日内，我要见到那张地契！”
看了王麻子一眼，金世佳的语气软化了下来。
“麻子兄弟，不是我不近人情，是后面的那位在催，我也是帮人跑腿办事……”
“金爷，我理解，理解……”
王麻子笑着说道。
“行！”
“那就这样，你抓紧办事！”
金世佳站起身，转身欲走。
“好的！”
“金爷，我送你！”
王麻子站起身，把金世佳送出门外。
“金爷，你放心，不过是一个浪荡子，以前他爹在，打猎队又抱团，不好下手，现在……”
王麻子嘻嘻笑道。
“不用送了，就到这里……”
院门口，金世佳示意王麻子止步。

他来到门口，探出头去，往左右看了看，见外面没人，一个闪身出了门顺着墙角溜走。
content_en:
"Sit."
Wang Mazi yawned, pointed to the chair opposite, raised his other hand, and rubbed the dark and large bags under his eyes.
"Did you stay up all night again yesterday?"
Jin Shijia sat on the chair and asked with a smile.
"Yeah."
Wang Mazi nodded.
"Master Jin, tell me, what's the matter?"
After saying that, Wang Mazi patted his cheek and tried to stay awake.
"What else could it be?"
"What happened to the matter I asked you about last time?"
Jin Shijia looked at Wang Mazi with a smile.
"Master Jin, my Master Jin, you just ordered me to do something yesterday, and now you come to me to ask about the progress. Boss, you have to take a breath even if you hang yourself!"
Wang Mazi complained.
"Hahaha..."
Jin Shijia laughed.
"Brother Mazi, it's not right to be an elder brother... However, the person behind me is a little anxious about this matter. I'm afraid that you, my dear brother, are busy with things and forget about it for a while, so I just want to remind you..."
"Brother, if we can do this well... the future will be long!"
Jin Shijia touched his chin beard and his smile became meaningful.
"Jin Ye, don't worry. How could I not take what you told me to heart? This thing is already being done. That kid has always wanted to join Heyi Tang. With a little trick, you can get him to take the bait!"
“When the fish lands, it’s natural to let them do whatever they want!”
"When the time comes, I'll be ready..."
Wang Mazi chuckled.
"Brother!"
Jin Shijia waved her hand and interrupted Wang Mazi's words.
"You don't have to tell me how to do it specifically. I just want the land deed, the land deed for two acres of irrigated land. If you can get it, the twenty taels of silver will be yours. If it doesn't work out, just pretend that I didn't say anything about it..."
"Anyway, I want to see the land deed within three days!"
After looking at Wang Mazi, Jin Shijia's tone softened.
"Brother Mazi, it's not that I'm unkind, it's the guy behind me who's urging me. I'm also running errands for others..."
"Master Jin, I understand, I understand..."
Wang Mazi said with a smile.
"Okay!"
"That's it, hurry up and get things done!"
Jin Shijia stood up and turned to leave.
"Okay!"
"Master Jin, I'll give it to you!"
Wang Mazi stood up and sent Jin Shijia out the door.
"Master Jin, don't worry, he is just a prodigal. In the past, his father was here, and the hunting team was in a group, so it was difficult to take action. Now..."
Wang Mazi chuckled.
"No need to send it off, just stop here..."
At the entrance of the courtyard, Jin Shijia signaled Wang Mazi to stop.
He came to the door, stuck his head out, looked left and right, and when he saw no one was outside, he ducked out of the door and slipped away along the corner.
